title: The first dove and the Spirit of God both hover but find no rest (Gen 8:9 and Gen 1:1-2)
summary: Compares Genesis 8:9 (the first dove, "Hovers, but No Rest") with Genesis 1:1-2 (the Spirit of God hovering over the waters), with the matching conclusion "SPIRIT OF GOD: Hovers, but No Rest". Both are shown with Hebrew references and Star of David dividers.

text.text: 9 But the dove could find nowhere to perch…
1 In beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
2 Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.
SPIRIT OF GOD: Hovers, but No Rest
